title: 12 grains of dust found high in Earth's atmosphere reveal secrets of water at the edge of the solar system
caption:
Twelve tiny grains of dust captured by NASA aircraft are rewriting the history of our solar system's water. These particles traveled all the way from the Kuiper Belt to reveal a massive reservoir of 'heavy water' that never reached Earth.

Source: Space - 12 grains of dust found high in Earth's atmosphere reveal secrets of water at the edge of the solar system
